description: This file contains functions and types for sending, editing, and managing messages and cards in Feishu, including reply handling, content parsing, and thread listing. It integrates with Feishu's messaging API and supports features like markdown and interactive cards.

methods.name: shouldFallbackFromReplyTarget
methods.description: Determines if a response indicates a fallback is needed based on error codes or messages.

methods.name: isWithdrawnReplyError
methods.description: Checks if an error object indicates a withdrawn or not-found reply target.

methods.name: sendFallbackDirect
methods.description: Sends a direct message as fallback when reply target is unavailable.

methods.name: sendReplyOrFallbackDirect
methods.description: Attempts to reply to a message; falls back to direct message if reply fails or is withdrawn.

methods.name: parseInteractiveCardContent
methods.description: Parses content from an interactive card JSON object.

methods.name: parseFeishuMessageContent
methods.description: Extracts readable content from raw message content based on message type.

methods.name: parseFeishuMessageItem
methods.description: Converts a Feishu message item into a FeishuMessageInfo object.

methods.name: getMessageFeishu
methods.description: Fetches a message by ID from Feishu, returning parsed message info.

methods.name: listFeishuThreadMessages
methods.description: Lists messages within a Feishu thread, supporting pagination and order reversal.

methods.name: buildFeishuPostMessagePayload
methods.description: Constructs payload for posting a message with markdown content.

methods.name: sendMessageFeishu
methods.description: Sends a message to a Feishu user or chat, with optional reply and mention support.

methods.name: sendCardFeishu
methods.description: Sends an interactive card message to a Feishu chat.

methods.name: editMessageFeishu
methods.description: Edits an existing Feishu message, either text or card.

methods.name: updateCardFeishu
methods.description: Updates an existing Feishu interactive card.

methods.name: resolveFeishuCardTemplate
methods.description: Resolves a template name to a valid Feishu card color template.

methods.name: buildStructuredCard
methods.description: Builds a structured Feishu card with optional header and footer.

methods.name: sendStructuredCardFeishu
methods.description: Sends a structured card message with optional header and note.
